name: Hip Flexor Strain
definition: Acute or subacute injury of the hip flexor musculotendinous unit, commonly involving iliopsoas or rectus femoris.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; MRI/ultrasound is used for suspected high-grade tear or avulsion.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Major avulsion or persistent weakness requires sports/orthopedic review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vankshana/Mamsa-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Acute or subacute injury of the hip flexor musculotendinous unit, commonly involving iliopsoas or rectus femoris.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
